slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: One descendant who blesses everyone? Genesis says every nation will be blessed through Abraham’s offspring. Acts applies that promise to Jesus.
slides.body: Genesis says every nation will be blessed through Abraham’s offspring. Acts applies that promise to Jesus.
slides.heading: One descendant who blesses everyone?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Gen 22:18: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.
slides.body: And through your offspring all nations of the earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice.
slides.heading: Gen 22:18

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Galatians 3:16, BSB: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
slides.body: The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. The Scripture does not say, “and to seeds,” meaning many, but “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Galatians 3:16

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Why Christians connect them This verse joins Abraham’s descendants with worldwide blessing. Acts and Paul both present Jesus as the descendant through whom that blessing reaches other nations.
slides.body: This verse joins Abraham’s descendants with worldwide blessing. Acts and Paul both present Jesus as the descendant through whom that blessing reaches other nations.
slides.heading: Why Christians connect them

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But “offspring” means a family too The previous verse compares Abraham’s offspring to countless stars and grains of sand. Genesis does not identify one person. Acts and Paul focus the promise on Jesus later.
slides.body: The previous verse compares Abraham’s offspring to countless stars and grains of sand. Genesis does not identify one person. Acts and Paul focus the promise on Jesus later.
slides.heading: But “offspring” means a family too

title: Does Genesis 22 predict Jesus blessing every nation?
